title: Run-Length Decode
statement: Read a run-length encoded string made of (count, character) runs, where each run is a possibly multi-digit count immediately followed by one character, e.g. '12a3b1c'. Print the fully decoded string, e.g. 'aaaaaaaaaaaabbbc'.
starter_code:
s = input().strip()

# TODO: decode the run-length encoded string `s`. Walk through it,
# accumulating digits into a count buffer; when you hit a non-digit
# character, repeat that character `count` times (default count 1 if no
# digits were seen), then reset the buffer. Print the decoded string.
hints: Keep a running string buffer of digit characters seen so far and convert it with int() once you hit a letter
Remember to reset the digit buffer after each letter is processed
